title: Half an order from the full boundary form defect
reviewed_arguments: All 26 original obligations, all 26 mathematical displays and all three complete solutions remain unchanged.

Both actual form domains and their supported/restricted distribution actions are explicit. Neumann ordinary derivatives are intrinsic restricted derivatives. Dirichlet first derivatives agree with derivatives of the supported H1 zero extension by density.

The fixed compact localization and proper auxiliary parametrices give fixed supports for every norm. A global variant retains the required uniform global operator seminorms instead of inferring bounds from properness alone.
Scalar componentwise leading symbols commute with fixed matrix coefficients. Complete ordered composition proves the loss of one symbolic order, including all residual and off-microsupport seminorms.

The mixed localization proof keeps at most one ordinary derivative on the right of each coefficient. Every patched normal commutator contains the exact lower-order coefficient times that derivative, with all fixed cutoff terms.
The complete PS4–PS5 order-one decomposition gives the H1-to-L2 bound with its actual left normal x factor, original distribution action and finite seminorm constants.
The microlocal error has residual coefficients before at most one ordinary derivative. Its bound uses only bare H1; no ordinary smoothing gain is claimed.

The half-order pairing uses the right parametrix, actual L2 adjoint and exact negative residual correction. Individual nonpositive coefficient orders make each adjoint move legal separately from the uniform target-order estimates.
The residual pairing is bounded by moving only coefficient adjoints to the residual factor, leaving the ordinary derivative on its original input. Cauchy–Schwarz then uses two bare-energy factors.

The full matrix-coefficient identity is verified by finite entry sums and the actual componentwise adjoint. Every principal, complex first-order and zero-order term is classified with its precise orientation and order.

The full complex defect is bounded at s minus one half on either form domain, for scalar localizers. The two exact source estimates and the homogeneous improvement follow from the current U058 proofs.
The imaginary-defect example has the positive 2iat term. The positive-form matrix example has a nonzero leading commutator and an unbounded ratio, with complete periodic foundations retained.

The residual lacunary dilation example has the exact inverse Fourier factor, compact support ratio, bounded H1 input and epsilon-inverse second-derivative output. Its nonzero smooth compact profile proves divergence.

The original order diagram is retained with one semantic correction: absolute-value bars on the complex pairing bound. All original operator paths, orders, hypotheses and the negative correction remain.
Vasy PDF 24–25 was read in full and visually inspected, with the preceding full source context retained. Its later propagation claims are not substituted for programme proofs.
